purpose: Review a finite issuer tax-position, tax-incentive, tax-compliance and jurisdictional-exposure disclosure domain before opening source rows, filing text, tax values, candidate values, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.exchange_enforcement_boundary: Campaign113 freezes exchange supervisory actions; it does not establish tax-authority audits, assessments, objections, settlements or jurisdictional tax exposure.
repository_evidence.commercial_terms_boundary: Campaign169 freezes customer and regulated commercial pricing states. Transaction prices inclusive or exclusive of tax do not establish issuer tax qualification, liability or compliance state.
repository_evidence.insurance_boundary: Campaign172 freezes risk-transfer source admission. Insurance premium or recovery tax treatment is not a substitute for a complete issuer tax-position history.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current annual-report tax note cannot be projected backward without first-public timestamps, report-period identity, entity and jurisdiction mapping, correction chains and effective law or qualification dates.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact issuer filing, tax-authority notice, statutory registry or licensed structured source with immutable bytes and stable observation identifier
first-public timestamp, trading-session availability, report period, legal effective date, qualification start and expiry, correction, withdrawal and supersession chain
issuer, listed security, subsidiary, permanent establishment, branch, project and tax-jurisdiction mapping without current-state leakage
tax type taxonomy separating corporate income tax, VAT, sales tax, withholding, customs, resource, property, payroll and other levies
statutory, preferential and effective rate identity; tax base, deductible item, tax credit, holiday, exemption, subsidy and qualification semantics
current and deferred tax asset or liability, loss and credit carryforward, expiry, valuation allowance, recognition, derecognition and offsetting semantics
audit, inquiry, assessment, uncertain position, objection, appeal, litigation, settlement, payment, refund, interest and penalty identity with outcome timing
currency, gross versus net, cash versus accrual, consolidation, intercompany, transfer-pricing, repatriation and withholding semantics
law change, transition, retrospective application, administrative guidance and issuer-specific approval timing without future leakage
missing, undisclosed, confidential, not-applicable, unresolved, true zero tax and zero benefit semantics without favorable absence coding
complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full-market denominator, issuer and entity identifier history, delisting coverage, pagination and one-shot acceptance gates
parser, identity, timing, unit, jurisdiction, tax-type, qualification, dispute-linkage and source-acceptance tests using no candidate, comparator, security-price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: statutory_preferential_tax_rate_incentive_holiday_or_qualification_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer or subsidiary qualification for a statutory rate, preferential rate, tax holiday, credit, exemption or other tax incentive.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No accepted history freezes tax type and jurisdiction, legal basis, qualifying entity or activity, application versus approval, start and expiry, renewal, revocation, first availability and comparable 2019-2023 full-market disclosure.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: current_deferred_tax_loss_carryforward_credit_and_valuation_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer tax asset or liability state including carryforwards, expiry and recognition or valuation allowance.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a complete point-in-time tax-note contract for current versus deferred items, temporary differences, loss or credit vintages, expiry, recognition, derecognition, valuation allowance, jurisdiction and restatement chains.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: tax_audit_uncertain_position_assessment_dispute_or_settlement_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known tax-authority examination, uncertain tax position, assessment, objection, appeal, settlement or payment state.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No accepted source links authority, tax type, period, entity, claimed amount, assessment, interest, penalty, objection, appeal, settlement, cash payment and correction timing without using later dispute outcomes.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: cross_jurisdiction_withholding_vat_customs_transfer_pricing_or_repatriation_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer exposure to cross-border, indirect-tax, customs, transfer-pricing or repatriation rules and obligations.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Entity and jurisdiction maps, taxable flows, treaty status, customs classification, transfer-pricing method, withholding basis, blocked cash, law changes, currency and first-public histories are not frozen in a complete accepted contract.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: income_statement_cashflow_subsidy_enforcement_or_company_type_tax_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An existing accounting line, cash flow, government grant, company classification or exchange enforcement event relabeled as issuer tax position or tax compliance.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Generic income-tax expense, tax payments, subsidy income, company type and exchange enforcement do not identify tax jurisdiction, qualification, disputed position, rate basis or carryforward state; renaming them would not create a new primitive.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: effective_tax_rate_cash_tax_burden_benefit_expiry_direction_or_window_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A transform of an issuer tax value, benefit, qualification, dispute or jurisdictional exposure against earnings, cash flow, assets, revenue or time.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing higher or lower effective rate, cash-tax denominator, benefit expiry, dispute severity, jurisdiction subset, recency, law-change window or peer benchmark before source admission would multiply hypotheses; low tax can reflect efficiency, incentive, loss, avoidance or distress.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_tax_benefit_burden_compliance_jurisdiction_gap_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: Joint issuer exposure across tax qualification, balance-sheet tax state, dispute realization and cross-jurisdiction obligations.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted heterogeneous source families or selecting weights, gaps, ranks, severity proxies, interactions, filters or models would expand the search before any component has a complete source contract.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four distinct enterprise tax states remain deferred at source admission; accounting, subsidy or enforcement relabeling, premature operator search and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.

next_action: Record all seven decisions in the Campaign173 hash chain, publish terminal accounting, and continue a different finite offline prevalue domain.
